name: What is the difference between a recessed light and a surface-mount light fixture?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a recessed light and a surface-mount light fixture?

acceptedAnswer.text: Recessed light fixtures are installed directly into the ceiling, creating a flush, streamlined appearance where the light source is hidden. They are often used for general ambient or task lighting. Surface-mount fixtures, conversely, are installed directly onto the ceiling surface, with the entire fixture body visible. They are easier to install and can provide more decorative options, often serving as a central light source.
acceptedAnswer.description: Recessed lights are flush with the ceiling, offering a hidden light source, while surface-mount fixtures sit on the ceiling, with the entire body visible.
